name: UGent.AI Brain-Inspired and Neuromorphic Computing Group
summary: The UGent.AI Machine Learning roster lists Joni Dambre with 'Brain inspired and neuromorphic computing' and Francis wyffels with brain-body optimisation and reinforcement learning, establishing a substantive brain-to-AI computational program.

name: UK Multidisciplinary Centre for Neuromorphic Computing
lead: Sergei Turitsyn (Director); Rhein Parri (Co-Director); David Saad (Investigator)
institution: Aston University, Aston Institute of Photonic Technologies
summary: The EPSRC-supported national centre co-designs brain-inspired neuromorphic hardware and algorithms, integrating human neuronal data with photonics and non-conventional computing to reimagine AI substrates.

name: Unconventional AI
summary: The company builds nonlinear physical-circuit and coupled-oscillator substrates, informed by neuroscience, to run neural computation at biology-scale energy efficiency, including a coupled-oscillator image generation model.
activity: Announcement of 2026 Unconventional Grant winners across Stanford, UT Austin, Yale, MIT and UC Berkeley; recent Un-0 coupled-oscillator image model release.

name: Valero Lab / Brain–Body Dynamics Laboratory
summary: Valero Lab combines physiological recordings, computational models, machine learning, and neuromorphic computing to create neuro-inspired robots, circuits, and algorithms, an explicit biology-to-AI translation.
activity: ©ValeroLab 2007-2026; news items and a PostDoc Position Available listing indicate recent/ongoing activity, but no exact dated activity within 2023-2026 is explicitly supplied.

name: VisLab — Computer and Robot Vision Laboratory
lead: VisLab leadership not specified on current page
institution: Institute for Systems and Robotics, Instituto Superior Técnico, University of Lisbon
summary: VisLab explicitly states twin goals of drawing inspiration from biology to build advanced artificial systems and modeling biological systems with computational and robotic tools, with a current project portfolio including humanoid robotics and body-motion foundation models.
activity: Project list includes BoMoX Body Motion Foundation Model (2025-11 to 2026-11), AI-Pack-Bot (2025-06 to 2028-05), and Nextgen HopOn (2025-04 to 2027-12).

name: Visual Information Processing and Neuromorphic Computing (Tiejun Huang)
summary: Tiejun Huang's Peking University program on visual information processing and neuromorphic computing, with a Brain-inspired Lab publishing 2026 ANN-to-SNN conversion and spiking-network temporal-prediction work coauthored with Zhaofei Yu.
activity: 2026 AAAI (oral) and 2026 ICLR papers listed on Brain-inspired Lab page.

name: Vivum AI
summary: Vivum develops evolutionary and dynamic neural AI using biological-intelligence principles, liquid time-constant and continuous-time recurrent networks, reservoirs, ODEs, and online adaptation for autonomous systems.
activity: Current company About and technology pages list leadership, address, Dynamic Neural Models, LTC/CTRNN/reservoir methods, and adaptive edge-AI work.

name: Vogels Group — Computational Neuroscience and Neurotheory
institution: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)
summary: The Vogels Group builds mechanistic models of synaptic plasticity, neuromodulation, and spiking network computation to understand biological learning and translationally inform machine-learning models.

name: Whole Brain Architecture Initiative
summary: WBAI develops brain-reference architecture methodology and human-brain-morphic AGI design, with active workshops, hackathons, and tutorials through 2026.
activity: 2026 WBAI Incentive Award call, FY2026 policy, ICONIP2025 brain-like AI design tutorial, Fifth WBA Working Memory Hackathon retrospective.

name: Xenobot Lab (Kriegman Group)
summary: The Xenobot Lab builds AI-designed organisms and adaptive robots to understand how animals evolve, grow, move, sense, and think, with a Northwestern robotics profile documenting his AI-designed-organism work and NSF CAREER award.
activity: Northwestern Robotics news page lists 'Sam Kriegman Receives Prestigious NSF CAREER Award' and 'Evolved Robots Are Born to Run and Refuse to Die'.

name: Yunnan Provincial Key Laboratory of Complex Systems and Brain-Inspired Intelligence
institution: Kunming University of Science and Technology
summary: The provincial key laboratory, directed by Liu Wenqi, explicitly combines complex-systems theory with brain and cognition coding/decoding mechanisms to develop brain-inspired AI with structural interpretability, cognitive transfer and emergent learning.
activity: Lab overview page dated 2026-03-20, with a companion 2026 open-fund call listed on the same site.

name: Zador Lab
summary: The Zador lab explicitly splits its work into auditory decision circuits, connectome sequencing, and applying insights from neuroscience to artificial intelligence.

name: Zenke Lab
summary: The Zenke Lab conducts theoretical research on how neural networks learn and compute, focusing on bio-plausible learning algorithms and spiking neural networks at the interface of computational neuroscience and machine learning.
activity: 2026 news items: Cosyne 2026; new paper Dreamer-CDP Reconstruction-Free World Models; SNUFA 2025

name: Zhang Tielin Brain-Inspired Cognitive Computing Group
institution: Chinese Academy of Sciences Center for Excellence in Brain Science and Intelligence Technology / Institute of Automation
summary: Canonical PI-led group with explicit biology-to-AI mechanism, current 2024-2026 activity, and independent countability.
activity: ACTIVE: UCAS official profile identifies Zhang Tielin as PI of the brain-cognition/brain-inspired intelligence laboratory and describes active SNN, biologically plausible plasticity, brain-inspired learning, and BCI work, with current publications and recruitment.

name: Zhu Neuromorphic Devices Research Group
institution: Ningbo University, School of Physical Science and Technology
summary: Zhu's group develops brain-inspired bionic neuromorphic devices and systems, including ionotronic artificial synapses emulating synaptic and structural plasticity for visual-tactile perception.
activity: Ningbo University research-direction page dated 2025-02-24 lists Zhu Liqiang under “brain-inspired bionic neuromorphic devices and systems.”

name: Zyphra Research
summary: Zyphra Research publishes work extending equilibrium propagation to skew-gradient systems including biologically realistic neuron models, framing this as a path to brain-like gradient learning without backpropagation.
